# CIJI — Ciji Bldg. Metalic Const. Ind. LLC

> Aluminium and glass facade contractor in Sharjah and Dubai, United Arab Emirates. CIJI designs, fabricates and installs curtain walling, structural glazing, spider glazing, skylights, space frames, ACP cladding, glass partitions, balustrades, doors, windows and gates.

CIJI is part of C.J Group of Companies, alongside C.J Tec Contracting LLC. It works as a specialist facade subcontractor for main contractors, developers and government authorities across the UAE, with design, fabrication and installation held under one contract.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://cijiintl.com/): who CIJI is, recent facade projects and the services it delivers.
- [About](https://cijiintl.com/about): the company, its group structure, mission, vision and capabilities.
- [Services](https://cijiintl.com/services): twelve product lines across the building envelope, with scope for each.
- [Projects](https://cijiintl.com/projects): delivered residential, commercial and industrial facade projects in Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi.
- [Contact](https://cijiintl.com/contact): head office and Dubai office addresses, telephone, email, office hours and map.

## Services

- [Structural Glazing & Curtain Walling](https://cijiintl.com/services#structural-glazing-curtain-walling): high-performance curtain wall and structural glazing systems for high-rise buildings.
- [Spider Glazing](https://cijiintl.com/services#spider-glazing): frameless point-fixed glass facades on spider fittings, glass fins, steel structures or tension rods.
- [Skylights](https://cijiintl.com/services#skylights): aluminium-framed and steel-structure skylights.
- [Space Frames](https://cijiintl.com/services#space-frames): long-span aluminium and steel space frames for roofs, atriums and feature architecture.
- [Aluminium Cladding](https://cijiintl.com/services#aluminium-cladding): ACP and precision-fabricated aluminium cladding systems.
- [Glass Partitions](https://cijiintl.com/services#glass-partitions): frameless and framed interior glass partition systems.
- [Stainless Steel Handrails & Balustrades](https://cijiintl.com/services#stainless-steel-handrails-balustrades): stainless-steel railing and balustrade systems with glass infills.
- [Aluminium Handrails & Balustrades](https://cijiintl.com/services#aluminium-handrails-balustrades): powder-coated aluminium handrail systems.
- [Gates](https://cijiintl.com/services#gates): sliding, swing and automated aluminium and steel gates.
- [Canopies](https://cijiintl.com/services#canopies): steel and aluminium entrance canopies and walkway covers.
- [Automatic Doors](https://cijiintl.com/services#automatic-doors): automatic sliding and swing door systems.
- [Doors & Windows](https://cijiintl.com/services#doors-windows): aluminium sliding, fixed, casement and thermally broken doors and windows.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The website has no enquiry form, no accounts and no online payments. Enquiries are made by telephone or email using the details above.
- Project pages list completed work by category and location; the site does not publish prices or lead times.
- The site sets no cookies of its own. The Google Maps frame on the contact page is the only third-party embed.
